goal: 依 PRD_2026-07-16_iOS版本.md 方案B:建立 ios/ 原生 SwiftUI App(min iOS 16,iPhone X 公務機),AVAudioRecorder AAC 錄音→Gemini generateContent 轉錄+潤飾,七模式,Keychain 存 key,歷史30筆;完成階段1-3+5(階段4實機驗收待使用者接機)
preflight_permissions: 新增修改 ios/** 檔案
依 rules/git-sync-whitelist.md 複製 Drive→mirror 並於 mirror commit(push 另請示)

acceptance.desc: A1 於 mirror 執行 xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO 回 exit 0

evidence.cmd: xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

acceptance.desc: A2 pbxproj 全部 target 之 IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=16.0

evidence.cmd: grep -c 'IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 16.0' ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj | grep -qx 4 && echo ALL_TARGETS_16 || (echo MISMATCH; exit 1)

acceptance.desc: A3 七模式 key 與 android/app/src/main/java/com/saysomething/keyboard/Prompts.kt 一致(潤飾/原樣/正式/訊息/Email/筆記/翻譯),prompt 內容等義移植

evidence.cmd: grep -oE 'id: "[a-z]+", label: "[^"]+"' ios/SaySomething/Prompts.swift | sed -E 's/id: "([a-z]+)", label: "([^"]+)"/\1|\2/' > /tmp/ios_modes.txt; grep -oE '"[a-z]+", "[^"]+",' android/app/src/main/java/com/saysomething/keyboard/Prompts.kt | sed -E 's/"([a-z]+)", "([^"]+)",/\1|\2/' > /tmp/android_modes.txt; diff /tmp/ios_modes.txt /tmp/android_modes.txt && echo MODES_MATCH

acceptance.desc: A4 Gemini 走 REST v1beta generateContent,音檔以 inlineData base64 附帶,模型與輸出語言可於設定頁選

evidence.cmd: grep -q 'v1beta/models' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -q 'generateContent' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -q 'inline_data' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -q 'base64EncodedString' ios/SaySomething/GeminiClient.swift && grep -q 'static let models' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift && grep -q 'static let langs' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift && grep -q 'settings.model' ios/SaySomething/SettingsView.swift && grep -q 'settings.outputLang' ios/SaySomething/SettingsView.swift && echo A4_OK

acceptance.desc: A5 API key 以 Keychain(SecItem API)儲存,程式碼中不得將 key 寫入 UserDefaults

evidence.cmd: grep -q 'kSecClassGenericPassword' ios/SaySomething/KeychainStore.swift && grep -q 'KeychainStore.save(geminiKey)' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift && grep -q 'geminiKey = KeychainStore.load()' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift && ! grep -q 'UserDefaults.standard\|UserDefaults(' ios/SaySomething/KeychainStore.swift && ! grep -n 'geminiKey' ios/SaySomething/Settings.swift | grep -q 'defaults\.' && echo A5_OK

acceptance.desc: A6 歷史紀錄上限 30 筆(超過裁切),持久化重啟保留

evidence.cmd: grep -q 'static let limit = 30' ios/SaySomething/HistoryStore.swift && grep -q 'prefix(Self.limit)' ios/SaySomething/HistoryStore.swift && grep -q 'JSONEncoder' ios/SaySomething/HistoryStore.swift && grep -q 'JSONDecoder' ios/SaySomething/HistoryStore.swift && grep -q 'UserDefaults' ios/SaySomething/HistoryStore.swift && echo A6_OK

acceptance.desc: A7 Info.plist 含 NSMicrophoneUsageDescription 繁中說明

evidence.cmd: grep -A1 'NSMicrophoneUsageDescription' ios/SaySomething/Info.plist | grep -q '麥克風' && echo A7_OK

acceptance.desc: A8 ios/README.md 含安裝步驟(開發者模式/Xcode Run)與 7 天重簽 SOP

evidence.cmd: grep -q '安裝步驟' ios/README.md && grep -q '開發者模式' ios/README.md && grep -q 'Xcode' ios/README.md && grep -q '7 天重簽 SOP' ios/README.md && echo A8_OK

acceptance.desc: A9 UI 含麥克風鈕/七模式切換/結果區/複製鈕/設定頁/歷史列表,並以 safe-area 適配 iPhone X

evidence.cmd: grep -q 'mic.fill' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q 'modePicker' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q 'resultArea' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q '複製結果' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q 'SettingsView()' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && grep -q 'HistoryView' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && ! grep -q 'ignoresSafeArea' ios/SaySomething/ContentView.swift && echo A9_OK

verify_cmds: xcodebuild -project ios/SaySomething.xcodeproj -scheme SaySomething -sdk iphonesimulator build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
